purpose: Promote Employee Core from READONLY to GENERAL so all eight qualified Core actions route to Cloudflare/D1 with no Apps Script business authority.
invariants: READONLY continues routing only the four Core reads.
GENERAL routes exactly the four Core reads plus the four qualified Core writes.
OFF routes no Core family action to /v1/employee/core.
Core GENERAL requires global/native employee routing; no legacy fallback is re-enabled.
Backend Core already exposes GENERAL in its D1 control schema and rejects writes while READONLY.
No Apps Script business authority is introduced.
Accounting remains READONLY and EasyStore is untouched.
Any Production mutation must be a later controlled gate with rollback.
